artworks.title: Landscape with a Well
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.2 × 11.1 cm (2 7/16 × 4 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image is an etching depicting a scene from an elevated point of view. On the left, a building with an archway and window with potted plants is visible. A figure stands under the archway. On the right, a well with a pulley system and a bucket is depicted. In the distance, there is a thatched-roof building on a mound with a tree nearby, emitting smoke from a chimney. The horizon is visible just above the roof of the distant building, with faint outlines of trees and structures. The etching features detailed and linear brushwork, depicting textures in buildings and natural elements. The color palette is monochrome, using varying shades of black, grey, and white to convey light and shadow, creating a calm atmosphere.

artworks.title: Landscape with Figure and Boat
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 5.3 × 9.5 cm (2 1/16 × 3 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape scene with a river or waterway. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, looking out over the water. In the background, there is a cityscape with small buildings and a few tall structures. To the right, there is a rustic house with a tiled roof, partially shaded, and a woman visible in a window. The scene is depicted in monochromatic engraving, showing clouds and sunlight radiating from the upper right corner. A person with a walking stick is on the left, observing a boat on the water. The color scheme is limited to black and beige tones, typical of fine etching.

artworks.title: Young Woman with Hands Folded, Facing Right
artworks.description: The image features a person standing upright with their head slightly turned to the left. The figure has short, curly hair and is wearing a wide-brimmed hat and a long gown with fur trims. Their hands are clasped together in front of them, with the gown revealing a patterned shoe. Below the figure is the signature "J. Callot inf."

artworks.title: Young Woman with Hands on Hips, Front View
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body illustration of a person standing with hands on their hips. The person's head is turned slightly to the left, with facial features drawn in a simplistic yet detailed manner. Their hair is curly and cascades down from under a head covering. The person is dressed in a long-sleeved garment with pleated details, a fitted bodice, and a high waist. A long, flowing skirt extends below, with gathered footwear. They wear a large collar around the neck and a headpiece draping down the back. The background is plain, and the figure is positioned above a ground line in a standing pose. The illustration style suggests this is an artwork or etching.

artworks.title: Young Woman with Distaff, Facing Right
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing upright. They are holding a distaff with spun fiber in their left hand and a spindle with thread in their right hand. Their face is turned slightly to the right, looking ahead. They are wearing a long skirt with stripes, a fitted bodice layered over a blouse with full sleeves and cuffs. A belt around their waist holds small objects. The person is wearing flat shoes. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Peasant Woman with Basket, Facing Left
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing upright. The individual is looking slightly to the side with a neutral to slightly confident expression. They have an oval face, defined eyes, nose, and mouth, and hair covered with a head wrap. The person is wearing layered historical clothing and holding a basket at their waist. Their shoes are simple with ties. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Peasant Woman with Basket, Seen from Behind
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 14.2 × 9.1 cm (5 9/16 × 3 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a person from behind, standing upright and holding a wicker basket in their left hand. The person is wearing a bonnet, a tailored dress with long sleeves, a fitted waist, peplum, and a long, pleated skirt. There are no visible jewelry items. The background is plain with minor imperfections or marks on the paper.

artworks.title: Peasant Woman with Basket, in Profile, Facing Left
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 14 × 9.2 cm (5 1/2 × 3 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing in profile facing right. She has a slight bend in her arms, holding a basket in front of her. The woman has detailed facial features with a calm expression, and her hair is tucked under a cap. She is wearing layered clothing, including a long-sleeved blouse, a shawl, and a long skirt with simple shoes. She is carrying a basket with one arm supporting it below, while her other hand seems to be adjusting it. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Bourgeoise with Muff, Facing Right
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 14 × 9 cm (5 1/2 × 3 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a standing person in full view. They have a neutral expression and facial features that include a softly outlined face partly covered by a hood. The person wears a long, flowing garment with a layered skirt reaching the ground, a fitted top with long sleeves detailed cuffs, lace, and a brooch-like element on the chest. The sleeves are puffed with intricate detailing. In one hand, they hold a cylindrical spool or bobbin. The figure is positioned against a plain background.

artworks.title: Young Woman, in Profile, Facing Right
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 14.8 × 9.7 cm (5 13/16 × 3 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a person in a side profile position with hands clasped in front of their waist, looking forward. They have short hair styled under a cap or hat. The person is wearing a long robe with an apron over it, detailed with pleats or folds. The sleeves are puffed at the shoulders, and the collar has a textured pattern. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Margaret of Austria on Horseback
artworks.description: This etching depicts a central person riding a horse, surrounded by other people. The central person is wrapped in a cloak with a large ruff and wears a hat adorned with a feather. A person walking next to them holds a large parasol. Behind this person are two others on horseback also wearing cloaks. One of them has a sword strapped to their waist. Behind the riding group are rows of men in hats walking on foot, carrying upright spears or pikes. The ground they travel on has small rocks, and the sky is gray.

artworks.title: Margaret of Austria Being Carried in a Chaise
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group in a historical setting. The scene shows several figures gathered around a central figure who is seated on an ornate chair. The seated figure is under a large canopy and is adorned in a cape and hat. Surrounding this figure are others dressed in period clothing, robes, and tunics, with some holding spears or poles. The background is filled with architectural elements and figures, lending a sense of depth and grandeur to the composition. The drawing style is intricate, with fine lines and shading executed with precise cross-hatching, capturing the textures of clothing and the details of the setting.

artworks.title: Margaret of Austria Receiving the Homage of Cardinals and Prelates
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people, with individuals standing in different positions. On the left side, there are three individuals - one standing on a raised platform, possibly a woman, wearing a long dress and an elaborate collar. The person to her right is in a cloak and hood, while another cloaked figure stands to her left. On the right side, there are men and women. The men wear long robes with buttons and some are gesturing with their hands. The women wear high-collared dresses. The background has vertical lines suggesting a textured wall, and the floor appears to be steps or a raised platform.

artworks.title: The Betrothal of Margaret of Austria to Philip III, King of Spain
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures in a classical architectural setting. The scene depicts several figures dressed in historical garments, interacting in a structured manner. The drawing uses strong lines and contrasts, with detailed attention to clothing and posture. The architectural setting features columns and arches, contributing to the classical theme and creating a sense of depth and space within the image.

artworks.title: Margaret of Austria Giving Audience to a Nobleman
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures gathered around a seated central figure. The image depicts an assembly of people, dressed in historical attire, engaged in a scene that suggests a meeting or discussion. The central figure is seated on a raised platform with others standing or kneeling around. The lines and hatching techniques used in this artwork create shadow and depth, giving it a dimensional quality. The figures appear to be in an indoor setting, possibly in a court or ceremonial environment. The style is reminiscent of classical or historical themes in early European art.

artworks.title: Philip II of Spain on His Throne
artworks.description: The image shows five men in a richly decorated interior. The man seated on the left is on a throne-like chair on a raised platform. He is in a full view sitting pose with a distinctive rough collar, a hat, long hair, and a beard. The man in front appears to be presenting or reading a document to the seated figure, shown from head to toe with detailed clothing, including a wide belt and a flowing cape. The other three men are standing around; one is closer to the viewer and holds a hat and a thin stick or staff. All the men wear similar historical European clothing with ruffled collars, doublets, and short trousers. The room is decorated with large curtains and a window with a gridded design, casting shadows on the floor tiles.

artworks.title: Philip of Spain before Margaret of Austria
artworks.description: The image features multiple figures wearing elaborate, period-specific attire. In the foreground, a man kneels with only the upper half of his body visible. He wears a fitted outfit adorned with a large ruffled collar. Standing before him is a person of apparent status, wearing a detailed, opulent robe with intricate patterns and a large ruff around their neck. In the background, a row of women stand in large ruff collars and formal gowns, with elaborately styled hair. Several men are also visible, wearing wealthy or noble garments. The surroundings suggest an opulent interior environment, possibly a palace or grand hall, with ornate wall panels and a decorative doorway. The atmosphere is formal and grand, captured by the precise linework of the image.

artworks.title: Triumphal Entry of Margaret of Austria
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a historical procession. The scene is set in an architectural environment with an archway in the background that features classical columns and statues. A canopy is held above an ornately dressed figure who is seated on a horse. This central figure is approached by a group of figures on foot, some holding lances and marching in formation. The foreground features elegantly dressed figures, with detailed clothing and headwear. The scene conveys a sense of order and ceremonial importance, with fine details in the clothing and architecture.

artworks.title: Italian Prince before Margaret of Austria
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group scene with individuals dressed in period clothing. The figures wear attire reminiscent of the late Renaissance or early Baroque period, featuring ruffled collars and elaborate cloaks. The individuals are gathered around a central figure on steps. The setting is a structured interior space with defined lines suggesting wooden paneling or drapery. The arrangement and posture of the figures suggest interaction or dialogue, with one central character gesturing towards the left of the frame.

artworks.title: Spanish Duke before Margaret of Austria
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a regal audience with a kneeling figure. The image depicts a regal scene where a figure is seated on a throne. The seated figure is attended by several figures standing around them, indicating a courtly setting. In front of the throne, another person is depicted kneeling. The scene is detailed with attention given to the textures of the garments and the architecture. The background suggests a harbor town or port, with masts of ships partially visible.

artworks.title: Philip as a Boy before Margaret of Austria
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a ceremonial gathering. The scene depicts a group of individuals dressed in elaborate, historical attire. The central figure is holding a small child, who is handed over by another figure. Both figures are facing each other, while others around them are observing. The backdrop features architectural columns and a dome. The linear details, shading, and attire reflect an intricate style.

artworks.title: Title Page for "The Capricci"
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate title page featuring mythical creatures. The center of the image contains a bold, curved inscription: "CAPRICCE DE DIVERSE FIGURES, INVENTES PAR JACQUES CALLOT EDOUARD ECKMAN SCVLSIT ET EXCV:". The text is framed by two symmetrically positioned mythical figures resembling satyrs, who are posed on either side holding large ornamental decorative elements. Above the text, there is a crowned emblem with intricate designs. The overall composition is decorative with high attention to detail, typical of a baroque style. The date '1621' appears below the central text.

artworks.title: Standing Woman in a Great Coat
artworks.description: The image shows two full-body illustrations of a person in profile view, facing left on the left side and right on the right side. The person is slightly turned at the waist, with their arms relaxed, and appears to be mid-movement, as if walking. The facial features are minimally detailed, and the hair is not clearly visible due to the wide-brimmed hat they are wearing. This hat has a soft, rounded structure with a slightly upturned brim. The individual is dressed in a long, flowing garment with multiple layers that drape elegantly to the ground. The fabric appears to be voluminous around the arms and falls in soft folds. The background of the image is plain and unadorned, framed by a simple, thin border.

artworks.title: Gentleman and His Page
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring two figures dressed in historical attire. The figures are depicted in movement, with one figure shown in action and the other in a confident stance. Both figures wear long coats and carry swords. The background is minimal to emphasize the figures. The drawing style includes fine lines and a monochrome palette.
